niche: a regional water district owned by its member municipalities, testing whether its lead service line replacement plan's annual capital finishes every zone by the federal deadline, and in which year each zone finishes, when the cost of each zone turns on how many of its unknown-material service lines prove to be lead or galvanized-requiring-replacement and nearly every field verification so far was prompted by evidence of lead
answer: At $25.4 million a year from 2027 every zone in the plan is finished inside the deadline: the last, RZ-10 Lakeview Terrace, is finished in programme year 2037, before 1 November 2037.

driver: The units still unexamined are what examinations that chose units by signs of the outcome left behind, so their rate is the population's expected count, taken from the only groups examined exhaustively, less the outcomes the examinations found, over the units left; carrying the exhaustive groups' rate itself to the unexamined units, or any rate fitted on the examinations, overstates them and moves the decision.
driver_concrete: Hollins Ford Regional Water District's plan carries every Lead Status Unknown service line at the share of lead or galvanized-requiring-replacement expected among the district's unknown lines of its construction era; the 78 main segments whose every service was exposed when the main was replaced give the share across every line of the era with no tap card (0.556, 0.316, 0.083), but the lines still unknown are the ones the visits raised by reports, leaks, sampling sites and a likely-lead ranking passed over, so their share is that expectation less the lead already found, over the lines left (0.497, 0.279, 0.075), and at $25.4 million a year the last zone finishes in 2037 instead of 2038 (or 2040 on every verification).
stump: A competent solver joins the verification log to the inventory through the migration crosswalk, keeps the lines that had no tap card record and prices each zone's unknown lines at the share found lead or GRR in each construction era across every verification, filing the last zone in 2040; the step that lands it there is pricing the lines still unknown at a share measured where something sent a crew, and the solver who sees the selection and takes the shares on the main segments verified whole still files 2038, because those are the shares across every line of the era while the unknown lines are what the targeted visits left; the whole-segment expectation less the lead already found, over the lines still unknown, finishes the last zone in 2037.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who joins the verification log through the migration crosswalk, normalises every material code and keeps the no-tap-card lines files 2040 pooling every verification (or with a model on every visible attribute); one who also reads the field notes' account, finds the 78 main segments verified whole and keeps the plan's eras still files 2038, carrying the share across every line of the era to the lines still unknown, which the targeted visits have already depleted.
domain_test: What decides the call is a water utility's estimate of how many of its Lead Status Unknown service lines are lead or galvanized-requiring-replacement: the inventory practice of estimating the unknowns' composition from the one sample that did not choose its lines (services exposed when a main is replaced), corrected for the lead that targeted verification has already taken out of the unknown pool; with another field's nouns there are no tap cards, GRR classes, main-replacement exposures, construction eras or replace-on-find, and the task does not read the same.
